title: Exponential form of the $q$-ary entropy
statement:
Let $q \ge 2$ be an integer and let $p$ be a real number with $0 < p < 1$. Then the base-$q$ power of the $q$-ary entropy $H_q(p)$ admits the closed form
\[
q^{\,H_q(p)} \;=\; (q-1)^{p}\, p^{-p}\,(1-p)^{-(1-p)}.
\]
replaced: Variant using a different exponentiation operator.
